question_punjabi: ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਤੇਜ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ 50 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ ਤਿੰਨ ਪਾਕਿਸਤਾਨੀ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੱਸੋ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਤੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਰਜਾਬੰਦੀ ਕਰੋ?
question_telugu: ఏ 3 పాకిస్థాన్ బౌలర్లకు అన్నిటికన్నా వేగంగా 50 వికెట్లు సంపాదించారు? సంపాదించడానికి రోజుల ఆధారంగా తాకువ నుంచి ఎక్కువ దాకా ఆర్డర్ చేయండి.

question: YM Nkanya took 50 wickets in the shortest calendar time. Calculate the exact days, name his country, matches, and achievement date?
query: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'YM Nkanya' GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS exact_days, m.country, m.match_number AS matches, m.match_date AS achievement_date FROM Milestone m WHERE m.rn = 1;
question_english: YM Nkanya took 50 wickets in the shortest calendar time. Calculate the exact days, name his country, matches, and achievement date?
question_hindi: वाईएम नकान्या ने सबसे कम कैलेंडर समय में 50 विकेट लिए। सटीक दिनों की गणना कीजिए, उसका देश, मैच, और उपलब्धि की तारीख बताइए।
question_punjabi: YM Nkanya ਨੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਸਮੇਂ ਵਿੱਚ 50 ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਲਈਆਂ। ਠੀਕ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਲੱਗੇ ਇਹ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ, ਉਸਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼, ਮੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੀ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: YM Nkanya అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ సమయంలో 50 వికెట్లు తీసుకున్నాడు. సంపాదించడానికి రోజుల సంఖ్య, దేశం, మ్యాచులు మరియు సంపాదించిన తేదీ రాయండి.

question: Sahibzada Farhan scored two T20 World Cup hundreds in the 2026 edition . Name both opponents and balls taken?
query: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opponents, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_taken FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Sahibzada Farhan' AND m.match_date LIKE '%2026%' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100;
question_english: Sahibzada Farhan scored two T20 World Cup hundreds in the 2026 edition . Name both opponents and balls taken?
question_hindi: साहिबज़ादा फरहान ने 2026 संस्करण में दो टी20 विश्व कप शतक बनाए। दोनों विपक्षी टीमों और लगी गेंदों की संख्या बताइए।
question_punjabi: Sahibzada Farhan ਨੇ 2026 ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਲਗਾਏ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: Sahibzada Farhan 2026 ఎడిషన్లో 2 T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పు శతకాలు కొట్టాడు. రెండు వ్యతిరేకమైన టీములు మరియు బంతుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.

question: Among all players with 5 T20I career hundreds, compare GJ Maxwell and RG Sharma across innings played, average, SR, sixes, and ducks
query: WITH BatterMatch AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixes FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS is_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(bm.match_id) AS innings_played, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(dm.is_out), 0)) AS average, (SUM(bm.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bm.balls_faced), 0)) AS sr, SUM(bm.sixes) AS sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN bm.runs_scored = 0 AND dm.is_out = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterMatch bm JOIN Players p ON bm.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals dm ON bm.player_id = dm.player_id AND bm.match_id = dm.match_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('GJ Maxwell', 'RG Sharma') GROUP BY bm.player_id, p.player_name;
question_english: Among all players with 5 T20I career hundreds, compare GJ Maxwell and RG Sharma across innings played, average, SR, sixes, and ducks
question_hindi: टी20I करियर में 5 शतक वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में जीजे मैक्सवेल और आरजी शर्मा की तुलना कीजिए: खेली गई पारियां, औसत, SR, छक्के और डक बताइए।
question_punjabi: 5 T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਸੈਂਕੜਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ, GJ Maxwell ਅਤੇ RG Sharma ਦੀ ਖੇਡੀਆਂ ਪਾਰੀਆਂ, ਔਸਤ, SR, ਛੱਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਡੱਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
question_telugu: 5 T20I శతకాలు ఉన్న క్రీడాకారలో GJ Maxwell మరియు RG Sharma ని పోల్చండీ. ఆడిన ఇన్నింగ్ల సంఖ్య, ఆవెరేజ, స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, సిక్సుల సంఖ్య మరియు డక్కుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.

question: Abhishek Sharma has the highest career SR among all players with 2 hundreds . Give his strike rate, hundreds, average, and calculate how many balls he faces per hundred on average?
query: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, CASE WHEN SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hundred FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), CareerStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(is_hundred) AS total_hundreds FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abhishek Sharma' GROUP BY d.player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.total_balls, 0)) AS strike_rate, c.total_hundreds AS hundreds, (c.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0)) AS average, (c.total_balls * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.total_hundreds, 0)) AS balls_per_hundred FROM CareerStats c JOIN Players p ON c.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON c.player_id = d.player_id;
question_english: Abhishek Sharma has the highest career SR among all players with 2 hundreds . Give his strike rate, hundreds, average, and calculate how many balls he faces per hundred on average?
question_hindi: 2 शतक वाले सभी खिलाड़ियों में अभिषेक शर्मा का करियर SR सबसे ऊंचा है। उनका स्ट्राइक रेट, शतक, औसत, और औसतन प्रति शतक कितनी गेंदें खेलते हैं, बताइए।
question_punjabi: Abhishek Sharma ਦੀ 2 ਸੈਂਕੜਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕਰੀਅਰ SR ਹੈ। ਉਸਦੀ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ, ਸੈਂਕੜੇ, ਔਸਤ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਔਸਤਨ ਹਰ ਸੈਂਕੜੇ 'ਤੇ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਖੇਡਦਾ ਹੈ?
question_telugu: 2 శతకాలు ఉన్న క్రీడాకార్లలో Abhishek Sharma దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద కెరీర్ స్ట్రైక్ రేట్ ఉన్నది. అతన స్ట్రైక్ రేట్, శతకాల సంఖ్య, ఆవెరేజ్ మరియు ప్రతి శతకం సంపాదించడానికి బంతుల సంఖ్య రాయండి.

question: Two teams suffered 4 stumpings in a single innings in T20I history — name both teams, their scores and opposition
query: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 4;
question_english: Two teams suffered 4 stumpings in a single innings in T20I history — name both teams, their scores and opposition
question_hindi: टी20I इतिहास में दो टीमों ने एक पारी में 4 स्टंपिंग झेलीं — दोनों टीमों के नाम, उनके स्कोर और विपक्षी टीम बताइए।
question_punjabi: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਨੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 4 ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਝੱਲੀਆਂ — ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: టీ20 అంతర్జాతీయ చరిత్రలో ఒకే ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో 4 స్టంపింగ్‌లకు గురైన రెండు జట్లు — ఆ రెండు జట్ల పేర్లు, వాటి స్కోర్లు మరియు ప్రత్యర్థులు ఏవో పేర్కొనండి

question: Australia scored 197/7 with 3 stumpings and still won . Name the opposition, venue, date, and calculate what percentage of their wickets were stumpings?
query: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, m.match_date, d.inning AS innings_number, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS stumping_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Australia' AND m.match_winner = 'Australia' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 197 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 7 AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3;
question_english: Australia scored 197/7 with 3 stumpings and still won . Name the opposition, venue, date, and calculate what percentage of their wickets were stumpings?
question_hindi: ऑस्ट्रेलिया ने 197/7 बनाकर 3 स्टंपिंग झेलीं और फिर भी जीत गया। विपक्षी टीम, स्थल, तारीख, और उनके कितने प्रतिशत विकेट स्टंपिंग थे, बताइए।
question_punjabi: Australia ਨੇ 3 ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ 197/7 ਬਣਾਏ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਜਿੱਤਿਆ। ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਮੈਦਾਨ, ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਸਨ?
question_telugu: ఆస్ట్రేలియా 3 స్టంపింగ్‌లతో 197/7 స్కోరు చేసి గెలిచింది. ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు, వేదిక, తేదీని పేర్కొని, వారి వికెట్లలో స్టంపింగ్‌ల శాతం ఎంత అని లెక్కించండి.

question: Which team suffered 1 stumping scoring 116 yet still won. Name the opposition, venue, date ?
query: SELECT d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = d.batting_team GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.venue, m.match_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'stumped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 116;
question_english: Which team suffered 1 stumping scoring 116 yet still won. Name the opposition, venue, date ?
question_hindi: किस टीम ने 116 बनाते हुए 1 स्टंपिंग झेली, फिर भी जीत गई। विपक्षी टीम, स्थल और तारीख बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ 1 ਸਟੰਪਿੰਗ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ 116 ਬਣਾਏ ਪਰ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਜਿੱਤ ਗਈ। ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: ఏ జట్టు 116 స్కోరు చేసి 1 స్టంపింగ్‌‌కు గురైనప్పటికీ గెలిచింది? ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు, వేదిక, తేదీ తెలపండి?
answer: ('Sri Lanka', 'Zhejiang University of Technology Cricket Field', '2023-09-25')

question: List all players who batted in Innings 2 and scored 70+ runs on debut. Give names, teams, and scores.
query: WITH PlayerDebut AS (SELECT player_id, MIN(match_date) as debut_date FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY player_id), DebutMatches AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.match_id, pim.team_name FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id JOIN PlayerDebut pd ON pim.player_id = pd.player_id AND m.match_date = pd.debut_date) SELECT p.player_name, dm.team_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS score FROM Deliveries d JOIN DebutMatches dm ON d.striker_id = dm.player_id AND d.match_id = dm.match_id JOIN Players p ON dm.player_id = p.player_id WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, p.player_name, dm.team_name HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 70 LIMIT 5;
question_english: List all players who batted in Innings 2 and scored 70+ runs on debut. Give names, teams, and scores.
question_hindi: उन सभी खिलाड़ियों की सूची दीजिए जिन्होंने दूसरी पारी में बल्लेबाज़ी करते हुए डेब्यू पर 70 या उससे अधिक रन बनाए। नाम, टीम और स्कोर बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਓ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਡੈਬਿਊ 'ਤੇ ਦੂਜੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ 70 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ। ਨਾਮ, ਟੀਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: రెండవ ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసి, తమ అరంగేట్రంలోనే 70కి పైగా పరుగులు సాధించిన ఆటగాళ్లందరి పేర్లను, జట్లను, స్కోర్లను తెలపండి

question: Spain have won two T20I matches by 1 wicket in their history. Name both matches with targets, opposition, grounds, and dates.
query: SELECT m.match_date, m.venue AS ground, CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Spain' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, (SELECT SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.inning = 1) + 1 AS target FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner = 'Spain' AND m.result_type = 'wickets' AND m.result_margin = 1;
question_english: Spain have won two T20I matches by 1 wicket in their history. Name both matches with targets, opposition, grounds, and dates.
question_hindi: स्पेन ने अपने इतिहास में 1 विकेट से दो टी20I मैच जीते हैं। दोनों मैचों के लक्ष्य, विपक्षी टीम, मैदान और तारीखें बताइए।
question_punjabi: Spain ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ 1 ਵਿਕਟ ਨਾਲ ਦੋ T20I ਮੈਚ ਜਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੇ ਟੀਚੇ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: స్పెయిన్ తమ చరిత్రలో రెండు టీ20ఐ మ్యాచ్‌లను 1 వికెట్ తేడాతో గెలుచుకుంది. ఆ రెండు మ్యాచ్‌ల పేర్లను, లక్ష్యాలను, ప్రత్యర్థులను, మైదానాలను మరియు తేదీలను తెలపండి

question: Which match had the highest number of no-balls ever recorded in a T20I? Name the teams, ground, date, and calculate what percentage of total extras in that match were no-balls alone.
query: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.venue AS ground, m.match_date AS date, SUM(d.noballs) AS total_noballs, (SUM(d.noballs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.extra_runs), 0)) AS noball_percentage FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY total_noballs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which match had the highest number of no-balls ever recorded in a T20I? Name the teams, ground, date, and calculate what percentage of total extras in that match were no-balls alone.
question_hindi: किस टी20I मैच में अब तक सबसे अधिक नो-बॉल दर्ज की गईं? टीमों के नाम, मैदान, तारीख, और उस मैच के कुल एक्स्ट्रा में से केवल नो-बॉल का प्रतिशत बताइए।
question_punjabi: T20I ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੁਣ ਤੱਕ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ No Ball ਹੋਏ? ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਮੈਦਾਨ, ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ ਅਤੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਮੈਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੁੱਲ ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨੋ ਬਾਲ ਸਨ?
question_telugu: T20I చరిత్రలో అత్యధిక నో-బాల్స్ నమోదైన మ్యాచ్ ఏది? ఆ జట్టు, మైదానం, తేదీని పేర్కొని, ఆ మ్యాచ్‌లోని మొత్తం ఎక్స్‌ట్రాలలో కేవలం నో-బాల్స్ శాతం ఎంత ఉందో లెక్కించండి.

question: New Zealand vs West Indies at Auckland ended in 31.2 overs with 359 combined team runs . Calculate the runs scored from non-extras and also calculate extras as a percentage of total team runs
query: SELECT SUM(runs_scored) AS non_extras, (SUM(extra_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)) AS extras_percentage FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = 1108;
question_english: New Zealand vs West Indies at Auckland (T20I #1108) ended in 31.2 overs with 359 combined team runs . Calculate the runs scored from non-extras and extras as a percentage of total team runs
question_hindi: ऑकलैंड में न्यूज़ीलैंड बनाम वेस्ट इंडीज (टी20I #1108) 31.2 ओवर में समाप्त हुआ और दोनों टीमों ने मिलाकर 359 रन बनाए। नॉन-एक्स्ट्रा और एक्स्ट्रा से बने रनों को कुल टीम रनों के प्रतिशत के रूप में गणना कीजिए।
question_punjabi: Auckland ਵਿੱਚ New Zealand ਬਨਾਮ West Indies ਮੈਚ 31.2 ਓਵਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 359 ਕੁੱਲ ਟੀਮ ਰਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਹੋਇਆ। ਗੈਰ-ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਕੁੱਲ ਟੀਮ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਜੋਂ ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਵੀ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
question_telugu: ఆక్లాండ్‌లో జరిగిన న్యూజిలాండ్ vs వెస్ట్ ఇండీస్ (T20I #1108) మ్యాచ్ 31.2 ఓవర్లలో ముగిసింది, ఇందులో ఇరు జట్లు కలిసి 359 పరుగులు చేశాయి. మొత్తం జట్టు పరుగులలో నాన్-ఎక్స్‌ట్రాలు మరియు ఎక్స్‌ట్రాల ద్వారా వచ్చిన పరుగుల శాతాన్ని లెక్కించండి

question: List the top 3 T20I matches with the highest no-balls per over ratio. Name both the teams and give the corresponding ratio as well.
query: SELECT m.team1, m.team2, (SUM(d.noballs) * 1.0 / (COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id || d.inning || d.over_number))) AS nb_per_over_ratio FROM Matches m JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2 ORDER BY nb_per_over_ratio DESC LIMIT 3;
question_english: List the top 3 matches with the highest no-balls per over ratio. Name both the teams and give the corresponding ratio as well.
question_hindi: प्रति ओवर सबसे अधिक नो-बॉल अनुपात वाले शीर्ष 3 मैचों की सूची दीजिए। दोनों टीमों के नाम और संबंधित अनुपात भी बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਓਵਰ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ No Ball ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵਾਲੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 3 T20I ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਓ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: ఒక ఓవర్‌కు అత్యధిక నో-బాల్‌ల నిష్పత్తి కలిగిన టాప్ 3 మ్యాచ్‌లను పేర్కొనండి. ఆ రెండు జట్ల పేర్లను మరియు వాటికి సంబంధించిన నిష్పత్తులను కూడా తెలపండి

question: Among the top 5 run-scorers in T20I history, give the strike rate , the average runs per innings for each, and rank them by batting average.
query: WITH BatterStats AS (SELECT d.striker_id, p.player_name, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS innings_played FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY d.striker_id, p.player_name), Top5Batters AS (SELECT * FROM BatterStats ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 5), Dismissals AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT t.player_name, (t.total_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.balls_faced, 0)) AS strike_rate, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.innings_played, 0)) AS avg_runs_per_innings, (t.total_runs * 1.0 / NULLIF(d.times_out, 0)) AS batting_average FROM Top5Batters t LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON t.striker_id = d.player_id ORDER BY batting_average DESC;
question_english: Among the top 5 run-scorers in T20I history, give the strike rate , the average runs per innings for each, and rank them by batting average.
question_hindi: टी20I इतिहास के शीर्ष 5 रन-स्कोररों के लिए स्ट्राइक रेट, प्रति पारी औसत रन बताइए, और उन्हें बल्लेबाजी औसत के आधार पर रैंक कीजिए।
question_punjabi: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ 5 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਲਈ, ਹਰੇਕ ਦੀ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਔਸਤ ਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਪਾਰੀ ਦੱਸੋ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਦਰਜਾਬੰਦੀ ਕਰੋ?

question: Babar Azam leads all T20I run-scorers with 4596 runs. Give his runs per match ratio and what percentage of his runs came in boundaries
query: SELECT (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p2 ON pim.player_id = p2.player_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Babar Azam')) AS runs_per_match_ratio, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(d.runs_scored)) AS boundary_percentage FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Babar Azam';
question_english: Babar Azam leads all T20I run-scorers with 4596 runs. Give his runs per match ratio and what percentage of his runs came in boundaries

question: List the top 5 players by catches per innings ratio also give the respective ratios.
query: WITH Catches AS (SELECT fd.fielder_id, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS total_catches FROM FielderDismissals fd JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.wicket_type IN ('caught', 'caught and bowled') GROUP BY fd.fielder_id), InningsPlayed AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS total_innings FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name, (c.total_catches * 1.0 / NULLIF(i.total_innings, 0)) AS catches_per_innings_ratio FROM Catches c JOIN InningsPlayed i ON c.fielder_id = i.player_id JOIN Players p ON c.fielder_id = p.player_id ORDER BY catches_per_innings_ratio DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: List the top 5 players by catches per innings ratio also give the respective ratios.

question: Who scored the most runs off a single over in T20I history, and how many runs were scored? Also name the bowler and the match.
query: SELECT p_striker.player_name AS batter, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 || ' on ' || m.match_date AS match FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date ORDER BY runs_scored DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Who scored the most runs off a single over in T20I history, and how many runs were scored? Also name the bowler and the match.

question: What is the shortest completed innings in T20I history by balls? Give the team, score, balls, run rate, opposition.
query: SELECT d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS run_rate, d.bowling_team AS opposition FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.result_type NOT IN ('no result', 'abandoned') GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team ORDER BY balls ASC LIMIT 1;
question_english: What is the shortest completed innings in T20I history by balls? Give the team, score, balls, run rate, opposition.

question: For each player who carried the bat through a completed T20I innings, calculate their runs as a percentage of the team total.
query: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs, it.team_total, ROUND((ps.player_runs * 100.0 / it.team_total), 2) AS percentage_of_team_total FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC LIMIT 5;
question_english: For each player who carried the bat through a completed T20I innings, calculate their runs as a percentage of the team total.

question: Shivam Dube scored consecutive fifties in 2 T20I innings. List both innings with runs, team name, opposition, and venue
query: WITH PlayerAllInnings AS (SELECT p.player_name, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, d.batting_team AS team_name, d.bowling_team AS opposition, m.venue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.match_date) AS inning_seq FROM Deliveries d JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name = 'S Dube' GROUP BY p.player_name, d.match_id, m.match_date, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.venue), FiftyInnings AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY match_date) AS fifty_seq FROM PlayerAllInnings WHERE runs >= 50), StreakGroups AS (SELECT *, (inning_seq - fifty_seq) AS streak_id FROM FiftyInnings), ValidStreaks AS (SELECT streak_id FROM StreakGroups GROUP BY streak_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT sg.player_name, sg.runs, sg.team_name, sg.opposition, sg.venue FROM StreakGroups sg JOIN ValidStreaks vs ON sg.streak_id = vs.streak_id ORDER BY sg.match_date LIMIT 2;
question_english: Shivam Dube scored consecutive fifties in 2 T20I innings. List both innings with runs, team name, opposition, and venue
question_hindi: शिवम दुबे ने लगातार 2 टी20I पारियों में अर्धशतक लगाए। दोनों पारियों के रन, टीम का नाम, विपक्षी टीम और स्थल बताइए।
question_punjabi: Shivam Dube ਨੇ ਲਗਾਤਾਰ 2 T20I ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਰਧ-ਸੈਂਕੜੇ ਲਗਾਏ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਰਨ, ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਦਾਨ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: శివం దూబే వరుసగా 2 టి20ఐ ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లలో అర్ధశతకాలు సాధించాడు. ఆ రెండు ఇన్నింగ్స్‌ల వివరాలను పరుగులు, జట్టు పేరు, ప్రత్యర్థి, మరియు వేదికతో పాటుగా తెలపండి

question: Who has played the most T20I matches in career history? Give their number of matches, runs, wickets, and span.
query: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id), RunStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), WicketStats AS (SELECT bowler_id AS player_id, COUNT(player_out_id) AS wickets FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired not out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY bowler_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches, COALESCE(rs.runs, 0) AS runs, COALESCE(ws.wickets, 0) AS wickets, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN RunStats rs ON ms.player_id = rs.player_id LEFT JOIN WicketStats ws ON ms.player_id = ws.player_id ORDER BY ms.matches DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Who has played the most T20I matches in career history? Give their number of matches, runs, wickets, and span.
question_hindi: करियर इतिहास में सबसे अधिक टी20I मैच किसने खेले हैं? उनके मैचों की संख्या, रन, विकेट और करियर स्पैन बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਕਰੀਅਰ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ T20I ਮੈਚ ਕਿਸਨੇ ਖੇਡੇ ਹਨ? ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਰਨ, ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ-ਕਾਲ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: కెరీర్ చరిత్రలో అత్యధిక T20I మ్యాచ్‌లు ఎవరు ఆడారు? వారి మ్యాచ్‌ల సంఖ్య, పరుగులు, వికెట్లు మరియు కాలపరిమితిని తెలపండి.

question: Which player holds the highest batting average in T20I career among players who have played 100 or more T20I matches? Give number of matches, runs, average, and span.
query: WITH MatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches_played, MIN(m.match_date) || ' to ' || MAX(m.match_date) AS span FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) >= 100), BattingStats AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id), DismissalStats AS (SELECT player_out_id AS player_id, COUNT(delivery_id) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') GROUP BY player_out_id) SELECT p.player_name, ms.matches_played AS matches, COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS runs, ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(bs.total_runs, 0) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ds.dismissals, 0), 0), 2) AS average, ms.span FROM MatchStats ms JOIN Players p ON ms.player_id = p.player_id LEFT JOIN BattingStats bs ON ms.player_id = bs.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissalStats ds ON ms.player_id = ds.player_id ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which player holds the highest batting average in T20I career among players who have played 100 or more T20I matches? Give number of matches, runs, average, and span.
question_hindi: 100 या अधिक टी20I मैच खेलने वाले खिलाड़ियों में टी20I करियर का सबसे ऊंचा बल्लेबाजी औसत किस खिलाड़ी का है? मैचों की संख्या, रन, औसत और करियर स्पैन बताइए।
question_punjabi: 100 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ T20I ਮੈਚ ਖੇਡਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ T20I ਕਰੀਅਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਕਿਸਦੀ ਹੈ? ਮੈਚਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ, ਰਨ, ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ-ਕਾਲ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: 100 లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ T20I మ్యాచ్‌లు ఆడిన ఆటగాళ్లలో, తన T20I కెరీర్‌లో అత్యధిక బ్యాటింగ్ సగటును కలిగి ఉన్న ఆటగాడు ఎవరు? ఆడిన మ్యాచ్‌ల సంఖ్య, పరుగులు, సగటు మరియు కాలవ్యవధిని తెలపండి

question: Which player has carried the bat through a completed T20I innings with the highest individual score? Give runs, team total, opposition, and date.
query: WITH InningsTotals AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, COUNT(wicket_type) AS wickets_fallen FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1 UNION SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number IN (0, 1) AND ball_number = 1), PlayerScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id), DismissedPlayers AS (SELECT match_id, inning, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.player_name, ps.player_runs AS runs, it.team_total, it.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM PlayerScores ps JOIN InningsTotals it ON ps.match_id = it.match_id AND ps.inning = it.inning JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON ps.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Openers o ON ps.match_id = o.match_id AND ps.inning = o.inning AND ps.striker_id = o.player_id LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON ps.match_id = dp.match_id AND ps.inning = dp.inning AND ps.striker_id = dp.player_out_id WHERE dp.player_out_id IS NULL AND it.wickets_fallen = 10 ORDER BY ps.player_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: Which player has carried the bat through a completed T20I innings with the highest individual score? Give runs, team total, opposition, and date.
question_hindi: पूर्ण टी20I पारी में कैरी द बैट करते हुए सबसे बड़ा व्यक्तिगत स्कोर किस खिलाड़ी का है? रन, टीम का कुल स्कोर, विपक्षी टीम और तारीख बताइए।
question_punjabi: ਕਿਸ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਨੇ ਪੂਰੀ T20I ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਟ ਆਊਟ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਸਕੋਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ? ਰਨ, ਟੀਮ ਕੁੱਲ ਸਕੋਰ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: పూర్తయిన T20I ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో అత్యధిక వ్యక్తిగత స్కోరుతో చివరి వరకు బ్యాటింగ్ చేసిన ఆటగాడు ఎవరు? పరుగులు, జట్టు మొత్తం స్కోరు, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు మరియు తేదీని తెలపండి.

question: Which player scored the highest runs on the losing side while batting in 2 innings, and what was the difference between their score and the highest single-innings losing score in the entire table?
query: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayersWith2Innings AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2), TopPlayer AS (SELECT p.player_name, pw.total_runs FROM PlayersWith2Innings pw JOIN Players p ON pw.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY pw.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1), HighestSingleLossingInnings AS (SELECT MAX(innings_runs) AS max_single_innings FROM LosingSideInnings) SELECT tp.player_name, tp.total_runs AS two_innings_losing_total, hs.max_single_innings AS highest_single_innings_losing, (tp.total_runs - hs.max_single_innings) AS difference FROM TopPlayer tp CROSS JOIN HighestSingleLossingInnings hs;
question_english: Which player scored the highest runs on the losing side while batting in 2 innings, and what was the difference between their score and the highest single-innings losing score in the entire table?
question_hindi: हारने वाली टीम की दूसरी पारी में बल्लेबाज़ी करते हुए सबसे अधिक रन किस खिलाड़ी ने बनाए, और उसका स्कोर पूरे तालिका में हारने वाली टीम के सर्वाधिक व्यक्तिगत स्कोर से कितना कम या ज़्यादा था?
question_punjabi: ਕਿਸ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਨੇ 2 ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਟੇਬਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਿੰਗਲ ਪਾਰੀ ਸਕੋਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਸੀ?
question_telugu: ఓడిపోయిన జట్టు తరఫున 2 ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లలో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసి అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన ఆటగాడు ఎవరు, మరియు వారి స్కోరుకు, మొత్తం పట్టికలో ఒకే ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో ఓడిపోయిన జట్టు చేసిన అత్యధిక స్కోరుకు మధ్య ఉన్న తేడా ఎంత?

question: How many players scored exactly 110 runs on the losing side, and how many of them batted in 2 innings?
query: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayerTotals AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_with_110_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_count = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS players_with_110_in_2_innings FROM PlayerTotals WHERE total_runs = 110;
question_english: How many players scored exactly 110 runs on the losing side, and how many of them batted in 2 innings?
question_hindi: हारने वाली टीम की ओर से ठीक 110 रन कितने खिलाड़ियों ने बनाए, और उनमें से कितनों ने दूसरी पारी में बल्लेबाज़ी की?
question_punjabi: ਕਿੰਨੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਠੀਕ 110 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿੰਨਿਆਂ ਨੇ 2 ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕੀਤੀ?
question_telugu: ఓడిపోయిన జట్టులో సరిగ్గా 110 పరుగులు చేసిన ఆటగాళ్ల సంఖ్య ఎంత, మరియు వారిలో 2 ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లలో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసిన వారు ఎంతమంది ?

question: In T20Is, which team posted the highest score despite having 4 or more batsmen run out in a single innings and still lost the match? Return the team, score, opposition.
query: WITH InningScores AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition FROM InningScores i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs >= 4 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, which team posted the highest score despite having 4 or more batsmen run out in a single innings and still lost the match? Return the team, score, opposition.
question_hindi: टी20I में, एक ही पारी में 4 या उससे अधिक बल्लेबाज़ रन आउट होने के बावजूद और मैच हारने के बाद भी सबसे बड़ा स्कोर किस टीम ने बनाया? टीम, स्कोर और विपक्षी टीम बताइए।
question_punjabi: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 4 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਨ ਆਊਟ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਕੋਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਮੈਚ ਹਾਰ ਗਈ? ਟੀਮ, ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਦੱਸੋ?
question_telugu: టీ20ఐలలో, ఒకే ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో నలుగురు లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ మంది బ్యాట్స్‌మెన్‌లు రనౌట్ అయినప్పటికీ అత్యధిక స్కోరు నమోదు చేసి, మ్యాచ్‌లో ఓడిపోయిన జట్టు ఏది? ఆ జట్టు, స్కోరు, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టును తెలపండి

question: In T20Is 2026, what is the instance where a team had 3 batsmen run out in a single innings? Return the team, score, result, opposition, and year.
query: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_score, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type = 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_outs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team) SELECT i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, CASE WHEN m.match_winner = i.batting_team THEN 'Won' WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL THEN 'No Result' ELSE 'Lost' END AS result, i.bowling_team AS opposition, strftime('%Y', m.match_date) AS year FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.run_outs = 3 LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is 2026, what is the instance where a team had 3 batsmen run out in a single innings? Return the team, score, result, opposition, and year.
question_hindi: टी20I 2026 में, एक ही पारी में 3 बल्लेबाज़ रन आउट होने की घटना कौन-सी है? टीम, स्कोर, परिणाम, विपक्षी टीम और वर्ष बताइए।
question_punjabi: T20I 2026 ਵਿੱਚ, ਉਹ ਮੌਕਾ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਹੈ ਜਦੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 3 ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਰਨ ਆਊਟ ਹੋਏ? ਟੀਮ, ਸਕੋਰ, ਨਤੀਜਾ, ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: In T20Is, which match holds the record for the highest match aggregate, and what was the run rate of that match?
query: WITH MatchAggregates AS (SELECT match_id, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 AND noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.match_date, ma.total_runs AS match_aggregate, ROUND(ma.total_runs * 6.0 / ma.legal_balls, 2) AS run_rate FROM MatchAggregates ma JOIN Matches m ON ma.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY ma.total_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, which match holds the record for the highest match aggregate, and what was the run rate of that match?

question: In T20Is, which bowler-batter combination has the most dismissals, and what is the batter's average against that bowler?
query: WITH BowlerBatterStats AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.striker_id AS batter_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.striker_id) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbs.dismissals, ROUND(CAST(bbs.runs AS FLOAT) / bbs.dismissals, 2) AS batting_average FROM BowlerBatterStats bbs JOIN Players pb ON bbs.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbs.batter_id = pb2.player_id WHERE bbs.dismissals > 0 ORDER BY bbs.dismissals DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, which bowler-batter combination has the most dismissals, and what is the batter's average against that bowler?

question: In T20Is, which bowler has dismissed two different batters 5 or more times each? Return the bowler, both batters, and the respective wicket counts.
query: WITH BowlerBatterDismissals AS (SELECT d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id AS batter_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.player_out_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), BowlersWithTwo AS (SELECT bowler_id FROM BowlerBatterDismissals GROUP BY bowler_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT pb.player_name AS bowler, pb2.player_name AS batter, bbd.dismissals FROM BowlerBatterDismissals bbd JOIN BowlersWithTwo bwt ON bbd.bowler_id = bwt.bowler_id JOIN Players pb ON bbd.bowler_id = pb.player_id JOIN Players pb2 ON bbd.batter_id = pb2.player_id ORDER BY pb.player_name, bbd.dismissals DESC;
question_english: In T20Is, which bowler has dismissed two different batters 5 or more times each? Return the bowler, both batters, and the respective wicket counts.
question_hindi: टी20I में, किस गेंदबाज़ ने दो अलग-अलग बल्लेबाज़ों को 5 या उससे अधिक बार आउट किया है? गेंदबाज़, दोनों बल्लेबाज़, और संबंधित विकेट संख्या बताइए।

question_telugu: T20Iలలో, ఏ బౌలర్ ఇద్దరు వేర్వేరు బ్యాటర్లను ఒక్కొక్కరిని 5 లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ సార్లు అవుట్ చేశాడు? ఆ బౌలర్, ఆ ఇద్దరు బ్యాటర్లు మరియు వారి వారి వికెట్ల సంఖ్యలను తెలపండి.

question: In T20Is, what is the highest partnership recorded for Japan, and which wicket was it for?
query: WITH DeliveryWithWicketsBefore AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id, delivery_id, runs_scored + extra_runs AS ball_runs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wickets_before FROM Deliveries), Partnerships AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before, SUM(ball_runs) AS partnership_runs, MIN(delivery_id) AS start_id FROM DeliveryWithWicketsBefore GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, wickets_before) SELECT p1.player_name || ' & ' || p2.player_name AS partners, ps.partnership_runs AS runs, (ps.wickets_before + 1) AS wicket, m.match_date FROM Partnerships ps JOIN DeliveryWithWicketsBefore dwb ON ps.start_id = dwb.delivery_id JOIN Players p1 ON dwb.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON dwb.non_striker_id = p2.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id WHERE ps.batting_team = 'Japan' ORDER BY ps.partnership_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, what is the highest partnership recorded for Japan, and which wicket was it for?

question: In T20Is, among players with zero ducks in their career and 30+ innings, who has the highest strike rate? Return the player, team, strike rate, and innings.
query: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT striker_id AS player_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS innings_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced, MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_dismissed FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning), PlayerStats AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ducks FROM BatterInnings GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(CASE WHEN innings_runs = 0 AND was_dismissed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0), PlayerTeam AS (SELECT player_id, team_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM PlayerInMatch GROUP BY player_id, team_name) SELECT p.player_name, pt.team_name AS team, ROUND(ps.total_runs * 100.0 / ps.total_balls, 2) AS strike_rate, ps.innings FROM PlayerStats ps JOIN Players p ON ps.player_id = p.player_id JOIN PlayerTeam pt ON ps.player_id = pt.player_id AND pt.rn = 1 ORDER BY strike_rate DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, among players with zero ducks in their career and 30+ innings, who has the highest strike rate? Return the player, team, strike rate, and innings.
question_hindi: टी20I में, करियर में शून्य डक और 30 या उससे अधिक पारियां खेलने वाले खिलाड़ियों में सबसे अधिक स्ट्राइक रेट किसका है? खिलाड़ी, टीम, स्ट्राइक रेट और पारियां बताइए।

question: In T20Is, how many times has a team scored 220+ when the opposition used only five bowlers and still lost the match? Return the teams, scores, and oppositions.
query: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;
question_english: In T20Is, how many times has a team scored 220+ when the opposition used only five bowlers and still lost the match? Return the teams, scores, and oppositions.
question_hindi: टी20I में, कितनी बार किसी टीम ने 220 या उससे अधिक रन बनाए जब विपक्ष ने केवल पांच गेंदबाज़ों का उपयोग किया और फिर भी मैच हार गया? टीमों, स्कोर और विपक्षी टीमों को बताइए।
question_punjabi: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿੰਨੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ 220 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ ਜਦੋਂ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਪੰਜ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਮੈਚ ਹਾਰ ਗਈ? ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: In T20Is, SR Watson scored the highest individual runs on the losing side. What was his score, which team did he represent, and who was the opposition?
query: WITH BatterInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team) SELECT p.player_name, bi.innings_runs AS score, bi.batting_team AS team, CASE WHEN m.team1 = bi.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterInnings bi JOIN Players p ON bi.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON bi.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Watson%' ORDER BY bi.innings_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
question_english: In T20Is, SR Watson scored the highest individual runs on the losing side. What was his score, which team did he represent, and who was the opposition?
question_hindi: T20I में, SR Watson ने हारने वाली टीम की तरफ से सबसे अधिक व्यक्तिगत रन बनाए। उनका स्कोर क्या था, वे किस टीम का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रहे थे, और विरोधी टीम कौन सी थी?
question_punjabi: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, SR Watson ਨੇ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ। ਉਸਦਾ ਸਕੋਰ ਕੀ ਸੀ, ਉਹ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਸੀ?
question_telugu: టీ20ఐలలో, ప్రత్యర్థి జట్టు కేవలం ఐదుగురు బౌలర్లను మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించినప్పుడు, ఒక జట్టు 220+ పరుగులు చేసినప్పటికీ ఎన్నిసార్లు మ్యాచ్‌లో ఓడిపోయింది? ఆ జట్ల పేర్లు, స్కోర్లు మరియు ప్రత్యర్థి జట్లను తెలపండి

question: What are the most T20I wins by a team against an opposition at a single venue without suffering a defeat?
sql_query: WITH all_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, venue, team1 AS team, team2 AS opponent, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') UNION ALL SELECT match_id, venue, team2, team1, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), venue_records AS ( SELECT team, opponent, venue, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 END) AS wins, COUNT(CASE WHEN match_winner = opponent THEN 1 END) AS losses FROM all_matches GROUP BY team, opponent, venue ) SELECT team, opponent, venue, wins FROM venue_records WHERE losses = 0 AND wins >= 5 ORDER BY wins DESC;
question_english: What are the most T20I wins by a team against an opposition at a single venue without suffering a defeat?

question: What are the highest individual scores for India in T20 World Cups?

question: What are the highest successful run chases in T20 World Cups?
sql_query: WITH innings_totals AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team ) SELECT it.batting_team AS chasing_team, it.total_runs AS runs_chased, m.venue, m.season FROM innings_totals it JOIN Matches m ON it.match_id = m.match_id WHERE it.inning = 2 AND m.match_winner = it.batting_team ORDER BY it.total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which players have scored 40 or more runs and taken 2 or more wickets in a single match in season 2026?

question: What are the highest partnerships in season 2026 for any wicket?
sql_query: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.delivery_id, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) AS wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) ) SELECT p.runs, p.wicket_num + 1 AS wicket, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which players have scored the most individual hundreds in T20 season 2026?

question: Which Pakistan bowlers took the fewest matches to reach 50 T20I wickets?
sql_query: WITH bowler_match_wickets AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_in_match FROM Deliveries d JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.bowler_id = pim.player_id AND d.match_id = pim.match_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'Pakistan' GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT bowler_id, match_id, wickets_in_match, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_id) AS match_seq, SUM(wickets_in_match) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_wickets FROM bowler_match_wickets ), milestone AS ( SELECT bowler_id, MIN(match_seq) AS matches_to_50 FROM ranked WHERE cum_wickets >= 50 GROUP BY bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, m.matches_to_50 FROM milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.bowler_id = p.player_id ORDER BY m.matches_to_50 LIMIT 10;
question_english: Which Pakistan bowlers took the fewest matches to reach 50 T20I wickets?

question: What are the highest targets successfully chased in 18–20 overs in T20 World Cups?
sql_query: WITH chasing_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_chased, MAX(d.over_number) AS last_over FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.inning = 2 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team ), last_wicket_over AS ( SELECT match_id, MAX(over_number) AS over_completed FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_id ) SELECT ci.batting_team AS chasing_team, ci.runs_chased, lwo.over_completed AS overs_used, m.venue, m.season FROM chasing_innings ci JOIN Matches m ON ci.match_id = m.match_id JOIN last_wicket_over lwo ON ci.match_id = lwo.match_id WHERE m.match_winner = ci.batting_team AND lwo.over_completed >= 17 ORDER BY ci.runs_chased DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the T20I head-to-head record of Rachin Ravindra against Sam Curran?

question: What is the T20I head-to-head record of Tim Seifert against Adil Rashid?

question: When was the first time in seven games that England failed to take a wicket in the Powerplay in this T20 World Cup?

question: How many times have both New Zealand openers survived the Powerplay in this T20 World Cup?
sql_query: WITH nz_batting_order AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, MIN(d.delivery_id) AS first_ball FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'New Zealand' AND d.inning = 1 AND m.season = '2025/26' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id ), openers AS ( SELECT match_id, striker_id FROM ( SELECT match_id, striker_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY first_ball) AS rn FROM nz_batting_order ) sub WHERE rn <= 2 ), pp_dismissals AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.player_out_id FROM Deliveries d WHERE d.over_number <= 5 AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.match_id) AS times_both_openers_survived_pp FROM openers o WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pp_dismissals pd WHERE pd.match_id = o.match_id AND pd.player_out_id = o.striker_id );

question: Which bowlers have bowled a maiden first over in the 2026 T20 World Cup?

sql_query: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, d.delivery_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.batting_team = 'Zimbabwe' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) AS wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, COALESCE(wicket_num, 0) ) SELECT p.runs, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.runs DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which players have scored 1000+ runs and taken 50+ wickets in T20Is?
sql_query: WITH career_batting AS ( SELECT striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS career_runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id ), career_bowling AS ( SELECT bowler_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 END) AS career_wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY bowler_id ) SELECT p.player_name, cb.career_runs, cw.career_wickets FROM career_batting cb JOIN career_bowling cw ON cb.striker_id = cw.bowler_id JOIN Players p ON cb.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE cb.career_runs >= 1000 AND cw.career_wickets >= 50 ORDER BY cb.career_runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which bowlers have the most consecutive T20I innings with at least one wicket for Full Member sides?
sql_query: WITH bowler_innings AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS took_wicket FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id, took_wicket ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS grp FROM bowler_innings ), streaks AS ( SELECT bowler_id, took_wicket, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM ranked WHERE took_wicket = 1 GROUP BY bowler_id, grp, took_wicket ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(s.streak_len) AS max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.bowler_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.bowler_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_innings_with_wicket DESC LIMIT 10;
question_english: Which bowlers have the most consecutive T20I innings with at least one wicket for Full Member sides?

question: Which teams’ openers have survived the Powerplay the most times in 2026 T20 World Cup?
sql_query: WITH batting_order AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id, MIN(d.delivery_id) AS first_ball FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2025/26' AND d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id ), openers AS ( SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id FROM (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY first_ball) AS rn FROM batting_order) sub WHERE rn <= 2 ), pp_out AS ( SELECT match_id, player_out_id FROM Deliveries WHERE over_number <= 5 AND player_out_id IS NOT NULL ), survival AS ( SELECT o.match_id, o.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN po.player_out_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS survived FROM openers o LEFT JOIN pp_out po ON po.match_id = o.match_id AND po.player_out_id = o.striker_id GROUP BY o.match_id, o.batting_team ) SELECT batting_team, COUNT(CASE WHEN survived = 2 THEN 1 END) AS both_survived_pp FROM survival GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY both_survived_pp DESC;
question_english: Which teams’ openers have survived the Powerplay the most times in 2026 T20 World Cup?
question_hindi: 2026 T20 World Cup में किस टीम के सलामी बल्लेबाज सबसे अधिक बार Powerplay से जीवित निकले?

question: Which team was the first to concede 250+ runs in successive T20I innings?
sql_query: WITH innings_total AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team, m.match_date ), successive AS ( SELECT it.bowling_team, it.match_date, it.runs_conceded, LAG(it.runs_conceded) OVER ( PARTITION BY it.bowling_team ORDER BY it.match_date, it.match_id, it.inning ) AS prev_runs FROM innings_total it ) SELECT bowling_team, match_date, runs_conceded, prev_runs FROM successive WHERE runs_conceded >= 250 AND prev_runs >= 250 ORDER BY match_date LIMIT 5;
question_english: Which team was the first to concede 250+ runs in successive T20I innings?

question: What are the top two highest-scoring partnerships at the best run rates in season 2026?
sql_query: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, d.delivery_id, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs, ROUND(SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) * 6.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS run_rate FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, wicket_num HAVING SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) >= 50 ) SELECT p.runs, p.run_rate, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.season FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY p.run_rate DESC LIMIT 2;

question: Which Indian batting feat marked the first time three or more batters scored 20+ runs at a 150+ strike rate in a T20 innings in season 2026?
sql_query: WITH batter_innings AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, ROUND(SUM(d.runs_scored) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS sr FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.striker_id ), qualifying AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, COUNT(*) AS qualifiers FROM batter_innings WHERE runs >= 20 AND sr >= 150 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT q.batting_team, q.qualifiers, m.venue, m.match_date, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = q.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM qualifying q JOIN Matches m ON q.match_id = m.match_id WHERE q.batting_team = 'India' ORDER BY m.match_date LIMIT 5;

question: Which bowlers have conceded the most runs in their first-ever over in T20 season 2026?
sql_query: WITH bowler_first_wc_match AS ( SELECT d.bowler_id, MIN(d.match_id) AS first_match_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.bowler_id ), first_over AS ( SELECT bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning, MIN(d.over_number) AS first_over_num FROM bowler_first_wc_match bfwm JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = bfwm.bowler_id AND d.match_id = bfwm.first_match_id GROUP BY bfwm.bowler_id, d.match_id, d.inning ), first_over_runs AS ( SELECT fo.bowler_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM first_over fo JOIN Deliveries d ON d.bowler_id = fo.bowler_id AND d.match_id = fo.match_id AND d.inning = fo.inning AND d.over_number = fo.first_over_num GROUP BY fo.bowler_id, fo.match_id ) SELECT p.player_name, fr.runs_conceded FROM first_over_runs fr JOIN Players p ON fr.bowler_id = p.player_id ORDER BY fr.runs_conceded DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is Sanju Samson’s T20 batting record at Chepauk?
sql_query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(s.runs) AS total_runs, ROUND(SUM(s.runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.dismissed),0),2) AS average, ROUND(SUM(s.runs)*100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.balls),0),2) AS strike_rate, MAX(s.runs) AS high_score FROM innings_scores s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Samson%' AND (m.venue LIKE '%Chepauk%' OR m.city LIKE '%Chennai%') GROUP BY p.player_name;

question: Who are the players to score 30-plus from No.7 or lower in a season 2026?
sql_query: WITH batting_order AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, MIN(d.delivery_id) AS first_ball FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ), bat_pos AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY first_ball) AS pos FROM batting_order ), innings_runs AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id ) SELECT p.player_name, ir.runs, bp.pos AS bat_position, m.season FROM innings_runs ir JOIN bat_pos bp ON ir.match_id = bp.match_id AND ir.inning = bp.inning AND ir.striker_id = bp.striker_id JOIN Players p ON ir.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON ir.match_id = m.match_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, batting_team FROM Deliveries) d_team ON ir.match_id = d_team.match_id AND ir.inning = d_team.inning WHERE bp.pos >= 7 AND ir.runs >= 30 ORDER BY ir.runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What are the highest partnership aggregates in a season 2026?
sql_query: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, wicket_num, MIN(CASE WHEN striker_id < non_striker_id THEN striker_id ELSE non_striker_id END) AS p1, MAX(CASE WHEN striker_id > non_striker_id THEN striker_id ELSE non_striker_id END) AS p2, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS balls FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, wicket_num ), pair_season AS ( SELECT p.p1, p.p2, m.season, SUM(p.runs) AS total_runs, ROUND(SUM(p.runs) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(p.balls), 0), 2) AS run_rate FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY p.p1, p.p2, m.season ) SELECT p1_player.player_name AS player1, p2_player.player_name AS player2, ps.season, ps.total_runs, ps.run_rate FROM pair_season ps JOIN Players p1_player ON ps.p1 = p1_player.player_id JOIN Players p2_player ON ps.p2 = p2_player.player_id ORDER BY ps.total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_query: WITH wicket_groups AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, MIN(CASE WHEN d.striker_id < d.non_striker_id THEN d.striker_id ELSE d.non_striker_id END) AS p1, MAX(CASE WHEN d.striker_id > d.non_striker_id THEN d.striker_id ELSE d.non_striker_id END) AS p2, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.delivery_id, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id, d.runs_scored, d.byes, d.legbyes, d.wides ), partnerships AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, p1, p2, wicket_num, SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) AS runs FROM wicket_groups GROUP BY match_id, inning, p1, p2, wicket_num HAVING SUM(runs_scored + byes + legbyes) >= 50 ), pair_edition AS ( SELECT p.p1, p.p2, m.season, COUNT(*) AS century_stands FROM partnerships p JOIN Matches m ON p.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY p.p1, p.p2, m.season HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) SELECT p1_pl.player_name AS player1, p2_pl.player_name AS player2, pe.season, pe.century_stands FROM pair_edition pe JOIN Players p1_pl ON pe.p1 = p1_pl.player_id JOIN Players p2_pl ON pe.p2 = p2_pl.player_id ORDER BY pe.century_stands DESC;

question: What are the most consecutive wins in Men’s T20 World Cups?
sql_query: WITH wc_teams AS ( SELECT m.match_winner AS team, m.match_date, m.match_id, 1 AS won FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END, m.match_date, m.match_id, 0 FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.result_type != 'tie' ), numbered AS ( SELECT team, match_date, match_id, won, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS rn FROM wc_teams ), grouped AS ( SELECT team, won, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team, won ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT team, won, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE won = 1 GROUP BY team, won, grp ) SELECT team, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_wins FROM streaks GROUP BY team ORDER BY max_consecutive_wins DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_query: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), teams_in_finals AS ( SELECT f.season, m.team1 AS team FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id UNION ALL SELECT f.season, m.team2 FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT team, season, LAG(season) OVER (PARTITION BY team ORDER BY season) AS prev_season FROM teams_in_finals ) SELECT DISTINCT team, season, prev_season FROM ranked WHERE prev_season IS NOT NULL ORDER BY season;

question: What are the fastest team 100s in T20 World Cup knockouts?
sql_query: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), cumulative AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.delivery_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM Deliveries d JOIN knockout_cte kc ON d.match_id = kc.match_id ), first_100 AS ( SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, MIN(over_number) AS over_when_100, MIN(ball_number) AS ball_when_100 FROM cumulative WHERE running_total >= 100 GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team ) SELECT f.batting_team, f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM first_100 f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE f.batting_team IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ORDER BY f.over_when_100, f.ball_when_100 LIMIT 10;

question: How has Sikandar Raza performed against Ravi Bishnoi in season 2026?

sql_query: SELECT d.batting_team, m.season, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored=6 AND d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored=6 AND d.wides=0 THEN 1 END),0),2) AS balls_per_six FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND d.batting_team IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') GROUP BY d.batting_team, m.season ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Who has made the most appearances in Men’s T20 World Cups?
sql_query: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS appearances FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND (m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') OR m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe')) GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY appearances DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Who has made the most appearances in Men’s T20 World Cup knockouts?
sql_query: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ) SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS knockout_appearances FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Players p ON pim.player_id = p.player_id JOIN knockout_cte kc ON pim.match_id = kc.match_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY knockout_appearances DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What are the highest match aggregates in T20 World Cup knockouts?
sql_query: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ) SELECT m.team1, m.team2, m.season, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id JOIN knockout_cte kc ON m.match_id = kc.match_id GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which teams have lost multiple T20 World Cup finals?
sql_query: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ) SELECT CASE WHEN m.team1 = m.match_winner THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS loser, COUNT(*) AS final_losses, GROUP_CONCAT(m.season, ', ') AS seasons FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loser HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY final_losses DESC;
question_english: Which teams have lost multiple T20 World Cup finals?

question: What are the T20 World Cup knockout trends since 2016?
sql_query: WITH knockout_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') ), ko_matches AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.match_winner, m.toss_winner, m.toss_decision, m.team1, m.team2 FROM Matches m JOIN knockout_cte kc ON m.match_id = kc.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND m.season >= '2016' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matches, SUM(CASE WHEN km.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_won, SUM(CASE WHEN km.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS batting_first_won FROM ko_matches km JOIN second_bat sb ON km.match_id = sb.match_id;
question_english: What are the T20 World Cup knockout trends since 2016?

question_punjabi: 2016 ਤੋਂ T20 World Cup ਨਾਕਆਊਟ ਦੇ ਰੁਝਾਨ ਕੀ ਹਨ?

question: What is the highest individual score in a T20 World Cup final?
sql_query: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides=0 THEN 1 END) AS balls, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id=d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN '*' ELSE '' END AS not_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.batting_team ) SELECT p.player_name, s.runs, s.not_out, m.season FROM innings_scores s JOIN finals_cte f ON s.match_id = f.match_id JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id JOIN Matches m ON s.match_id = m.match_id ORDER BY s.runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What are the most sixes in a innings in season 2026?
sql_query: SELECT d.batting_team, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored = 6 AND d.wides = 0 THEN 1 END) AS sixes, m.team1, m.team2, m.season FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, m.team1, m.team2, m.season ORDER BY sixes DESC LIMIT 10;
question_english: What are the most sixes in a innings in season 2026?

question: What are the highest team totals in season 2026?
sql_query: SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets_lost, m.season, CASE WHEN m.team1 = d.batting_team THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS opponent FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season = '2026' GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, m.season, opponent ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which players have scored 50+ in both the semifinal and final of a T20 World Cup edition?
sql_query: WITH km AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season ORDER BY m.match_date DESC) AS rnk FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') ), final_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ), semi_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, km.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN km ON d.match_id = km.match_id WHERE km.rnk IN (2,3) GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, km.season HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50 ) SELECT p.player_name, ss.season FROM semi_scores ss JOIN final_scores fs ON ss.striker_id = fs.striker_id AND ss.season = fs.season JOIN Players p ON ss.striker_id = p.player_id ORDER BY ss.season;
question_english: Which players have scored 50+ in both the semifinal and final of a T20 World Cup edition?

question_telugu: T20 World Cup ఒక ఎడిషన్‌లో సెమీఫైనల్ మరియు ఫైనల్ రెండింటిలో 50+ రన్లు చేసిన ఆటగాళ్ళు ఎవరు?

question: Who has the most consecutive 50+ scores in T20 World Cups?
sql_query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning, m.match_date ), numbered AS ( SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, match_date, runs, CASE WHEN runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fifty_plus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id, inning) AS rn FROM innings_scores ), grouped AS ( SELECT striker_id, fifty_plus, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id, fifty_plus ORDER BY rn) AS grp FROM numbered ), streaks AS ( SELECT striker_id, grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM grouped WHERE fifty_plus = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, grp ) SELECT p.player_name, MAX(streak_len) AS max_consecutive_50_plus FROM streaks s JOIN Players p ON s.striker_id = p.player_id GROUP BY s.striker_id, p.player_name ORDER BY max_consecutive_50_plus DESC LIMIT 10;
question_english: Who has the most consecutive 50+ scores in T20 World Cups?

question: How many T20 World Cup finals has India reached?
sql_query: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS finals_reached FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.team1 = 'India' OR m.team2 = 'India';
question_english: How many T20 World Cup finals has India reached?

question: What is the chasing vs defending record in T20 World Cup finals?
sql_query: WITH finals_cte AS ( SELECT m.match_id, m.season FROM Matches m WHERE m.season IN ('2007','2009','2010','2012','2014','2016','2021/22','2022/23','2024','2025/26') AND m.team1 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.team2 IN ('Afghanistan','Australia','Bangladesh','England','India','Ireland','New Zealand','Pakistan','South Africa','Sri Lanka','West Indies','Zimbabwe') AND m.stage = 'Final' ), second_bat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS chasing_team FROM Deliveries WHERE inning = 2 ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chasing_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != sb.chasing_team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defending_wins, COUNT(*) AS total_finals FROM finals_cte f JOIN Matches m ON f.match_id = m.match_id JOIN second_bat sb ON f.match_id = sb.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;
question_english: What is the chasing vs defending record in T20 World Cup finals?
